runAssessment.summary: The run ultimately delivered credible verification of the existing library application: all 7 tests passed, fresh live API probes exercised the required success and error paths, and the 390px browser check succeeded. It cost $0.2124 over 587 seconds. The outcome is supported, but the run spent a substantial share on an uncredited 70-tool-call execution followed by a 76-tool-call retry, including repeated probes against contaminated state and several failed browser checks before establishing a fresh fixture.

findings.title: Stateful verification consumed most execution work before establishing a fresh fixture
findings.detail: The first completed execution made 70 tool calls but received no credit. Its live data already contained unavailable books and fines, so requests labelled as premium loans 3–5 returned 409 without demonstrating the premium limit. The retry then reread the same eight files and performed another 76 calls, eventually creating a fresh data file and obtaining valid evidence. Preventing this requires a policy choice about when verification must establish fresh state and when repeated probe sequences should be abandoned or reset.

findings.title: Validator-driven recovery corrected the evidence gap
findings.detail: The initial result was rejected and coaching explicitly directed the executor to verify the premium sixth-loan rule and repeat the API/browser checks. The subsequent execution used a fresh data file, passed the test suite, demonstrated renewals and the third-renewal refusal, and was accepted. This recovery worked, although it was costly.

evidence.quote: Fix the premium active-loan limit so the sixth loan returns 409. Re-run the live API matrix and browser smoke at 390px until all probes have consoleErrors=0 and every smoke result is ok.
Earlier failed smoke probes were followed by successful corrected validations.

planning.summary: Meristem produced one end-to-end continuation branch, routed it to a full-stack executor, and the initial detailed plan received strong checklist coverage. After rejection, the plan was narrowed appropriately to the missing premium-limit and browser/API evidence.

evidence.quote: Fix the premium active-loan limit so the sixth loan returns 409.

delegation.summary: Routing was coherent: Meristem selected Protoplast, which selected CarbonDioxide for the single full-stack branch and injected the matched persisted-JSON-API skill. No fan-out or join coordination was needed beyond the single sequential branch.

execution.summary: Execution made useful progress and ultimately produced valid tests and probes, but it was inefficient: the uncredited first trajectory used 70 calls and the credited retry used 76. The retry reread all project files, established a fresh data file, and completed the required API and browser work.
